definitions.gloss: slight, small in quantity or degree
definitions.explanation: Describes something that exists in a very small amount or to a very small degree. Often implies insufficiency or emphasizes how surprisingly small something is.

examples.japanese: {僅|わず}かな⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
examples.english: I lost by a slight margin.

examples.japanese: {僅|わず}かな⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧しか⟦{残|のこ}っていない→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There is only a little time left.

examples.japanese: {僅|わず}かな⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{崩|くず}して→切り崩す：06844_kirikuzusu⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}していた→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I was living by gradually using up my meager savings.

notes:
USAGE:
Emphasizes smallness in quantity, amount, or degree. Often carries a nuance of "only" or "merely" — highlighting that something is less than expected. The adverbial form {僅|わず}かに is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {僅|わず}かな⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (slight difference)
- {僅|わず}かな⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (a short time)
- {僅|わず}かな⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧ (a small amount of money)
- {僅|わず}かな⟦{望|のぞ}み→望み：03543_nozomi⟧ (a slim hope)
- {僅|わず}かな⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (a small quantity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{微|かす}か→微か：10301_kasuka⟧な: emphasizes faintness or weak perceptibility, while {僅|わず}かな emphasizes smallness of quantity or degree
- ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: simply means "few" or "little" without the emphatic nuance of {僅|わず}かな
